items.text:
The title's opening double quotes are wrong (99, not 66).
The opening settings don't let you choose full screen. It turns out it is an unlabelled icon.
The opening tutorial shows you how to control the hand and fingers. Then it turns out you can't do that in the game, and just press letters for thoughts.
It's one of those things that has you mildly annoyed before the "game" begins.
items.text_zh:
标题开头的双引号是错的（应该是99，不是66）。
开头的设置不让你选择全屏。结果发现那是个没有标签的图标。
开头的教程教你如何控制手和手指。然后结果发现你在游戏里做不到，只能按字母来思考。
这就是那种在“游戏”开始之前就让你有点恼火的东西。

observations.description: 教程展示手和手指的控制，但实际游戏中无法使用，只能按字母键
observations.evidence: The opening tutorial shows you how to control the hand and fingers. Then it turns out you can't do that in the game, and just press letters for thoughts.
observations.evidence_zh: 开头的教程向你展示如何控制手和手指。结果在游戏里你根本不能那么做，只能按字母来产生想法。
